richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Karaikudi

c: Karaikudi is the heart of Chettinad, and its restored mansions now host heritage hotels with courtyards and gardens that suit a quiet outdoor gym. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to heritage hotels, Alagappa University and other colleges, schools, housing layouts and parks in Karaikudi. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,210 km away, and travel to Tamil Nadu by road.

A heritage property needs equipment that sits back in the garden and does not compete with the building. A few machines in a corner, in a colour that suits the walls, often work best. The dry, hot climate of this part of Tamil Nadu means shade is worth planning. Our installation crew or a dealer in south India fixes each base. Send photos of the garden, and we will propose a layout and colour.

items.q: Can a heritage hotel in Karaikudi add an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. A small set of machines in a garden corner gives guests a place to exercise without any change to the building. We can suggest a colour that suits the property.

items.q: Do you supply colleges in Karaikudi?
items.a: Yes. We supply colleges, universities and schools as well as hotels. Send us the ground size and photos, and we will plan a set of machines with a layout drawing.
Our own installation team or a dealer in south India. They follow the approved layout and fix each machine on a grouted or self-standing base.
